method: Actual shipped scripts in Node VM; prop draw commands and pinned Three material objects. No browser/GPU/natural play.

checks.name: All 62 canonical scenes have an explicit environment family
All 55 combat maps receive the same environment pass
No whole-map backdrop or photographed source bridge is rendered
Terrain uses bounded top-down material crops with original aspect
Every placed prop has clearance from exact current maze walls
Scenery is distributed across at least 12 broad combat rooms per map
Every map uses 8–12 selected narrative props without adding solids
Original regional prop IDs, paths, collision flags and source metadata are preserved
Repeated dressing neither duplicates nor moves existing objects
Cave tree placeholders render as existing cave bone/stone art
Cave and swamp retain distinct source art and environment treatment
Canonical command, memory and objective scenes avoid obsolete canal/vat/court art
Hospital layout and its eleven original props are excluded from world dressing
Cave placeholder render emits original cave asset draw commands, not tree atlas
Actual Three materials receive scene-specific floor/wall/cap separation
